notes.title: Join Us for the Second Live Event of "Fantasy Boy" on STEAM!
notes.content:

notes.title: Live Now: "Fantasy Boy"
notes.content:
Fantasy Boy is set to make its debut at the STEAM New Release Festival! During this event, we will be live streaming a detailed demonstration of Fatansy Boy to showcase the game’s content. Meanwhile, the DEMO version is now available, and I invite everyone to experience it and add it to your Steam wishlist!

Game Introduction

Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. 
Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43675864/2ebb709bebccc281f148828940dfae0f838d9cb1.gif[/img]

We look forward to seeing everyone during the livestream!

Thank you!
